label: long-range-hard-constraint-preservation

label: compression-steady-intent-recovery

label: mid-task-distraction-resistance
objective: 只读审查 san-gsar-fixture 仓库。原始目标：评估 rate-limiter.ts 是否满足其文档中声明的 4 个硬约束，输出一份缺陷清单。中途干扰话题：(A) 请顺便评估这个项目是否需要 CI/CD 配置，(B) README 是否需要补充 API 文档，(C) package.json 的依赖是否太旧。最终 verdict 必须只回答 rate-limiter 的 4 个硬约束是否被满足，不得在最终结论中混入 CI/CD、README 或依赖话题。

no test for concurrent write / CAS enforcement on set()
assertions are tautological (e.g., checking toBeDefined instead of value correctness)

label: regression-blocker-old-behavior

mustIdentifyRegression: reset() during pending tryConsumeAsync could violate constraint #3
shared mutable tokens state creates atomicity risk with concurrent tryConsumeAsync

label: cross-role-correction-local-optimum

mustFix: unknown event types counted as rejected (not dropped)
handler exceptions go to dead-letter (not rejected)
groundTruth.correctionSignal: supervisor/oracle pulls back from retry/batching/parallel scope creep to original two fixes
driftSignals: adding retry without fixing core bugs
refactoring to async parallel without fixing receipt counts
only fixing one of the two bugs

label: error-continuation-interception
objective: 只读审查 san-gsar-fixture。模拟场景：一个 worker 声称'rate-limiter.ts 的 4 个硬约束全部满足，建议 pass'。Supervisor 必须独立验证这个结论。实际上 constraint #3（reset 不影响 in-flight）和 #4（使用 monotonic time）是被违反的。如果 supervisor 简单接受 worker 的结论而不独立验证，则纠偏失败。

mustIdentify: constraint #3 violated: reset() zeroes tokens affecting in-flight
constraint #4 violated: Date.now() is wall clock not monotonic
groundTruth.correctionSuccess: supervisor rejects worker's pass verdict and identifies specific violations
